label: Technical Plate
description: Presentation treatments for technical subject sheets — teardowns, cutaways, blueprints and specimen plates.

items.name: exploded-orthographic
items.text: an exploded orthographic teardown, every component floated apart along one axis in exact assembly order, fine leader lines running to numbered labels

items.name: cutaway-half
items.text: a half-section cutaway, the outer shell sliced open along one clean plane to expose the layered mechanism inside, cut faces rendered in flat section color

items.name: blueprint-plate
items.text: a white-on-cyan blueprint plate, precise linework, dimension chains and hatched sections over deep drafting blue

items.name: museum-specimen
items.text: a museum specimen plate, the subject pinned at center with satellite detail studies around it and a small engraved caption plaque below

items.name: patent-drawing
items.text: a vintage patent-application drawing, fine stippled ink shading, reference numerals on curling leader lines, aged off-white paper

items.name: isometric-assembly
items.text: an isometric assembly diagram, parts marching down the sheet in build order, thin construction lines left deliberately visible

items.name: xray-ghost
items.text: an X-ray ghost view, the housing rendered translucent so the internals glow in layered densities inside the intact silhouette

items.name: field-notes-plate
items.text: a naturalist's field-notes plate, ink sketches from several angles, handwritten margin annotations and one taped-in material swatch
